about.title: Our Philosophy
about.p1: Aiki Jutsu is more than just a martial art; it is a path of harmony, discipline, and continuous self-improvement. The dojo is a place where students learn to blend with energy, resolve conflict peacefully, and develop a strong character.
about.p2: This platform was created to bridge the gap between traditional dojo training and modern technology. It allows students to review techniques at home, track their progress accurately, and stay connected with their Sensei.
about.p3: To provide martial artists with the best tools to organize their curriculum, monitor their growth, and preserve the rich heritage of Aiki Jutsu for generations to come.
about.q1: Do I need an account to use the app?
about.a1: Yes, an account is required to track your personal progress and securely connect with your Sensei.
about.q2: Can I use the app without a Sensei?
about.a2: While you can explore the syllabus, belt validations and full access to the dojo community are approved by your Sensei.
about.a3: Once you complete all techniques for your current belt, you request a validation. Your Sensei reviews your progress in the app and promotes you.
about.a4: It's an integrated artificial intelligence assistant that knows your progress and the app's features, ready to answer your questions 24/7.
about.a5: You earn XP by claiming rewards for your dedication, completing quizzes, and maintaining training streaks.
about.a6: Yes, we use Firebase Authentication and strict Firestore security rules to ensure only you and your Sensei can see your data.
about.q7: Can I use this on my phone?
about.a7: Absolutely. The platform is fully responsive and works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
about.q8: What if I forget my password?
about.a8: You can reset it directly from the login page. A secure link will be sent to your registered email address.
about.q9: Are the techniques available for all belts?
about.a9: You only see techniques up to your current belt level. Higher belts unlock automatically when your Sensei promotes you.
about.q10: Can I track my progress offline?
about.a10: You can install the app and browse the syllabus offline. However, an internet connection is required to sync your progress securely with the database.
